summary: Two structural changes, by owner decision. First, the fuller enumeration is now public: 54 further recommendations found by reading the Foreword and chapters 1 to 5 in full appear on the page, each marked, and feed a second figure shown under the headline. They never enter the key-objective headline. Each has had one independent AI review and a blind significance score; none has had a red-team pass. Second, Foreword items are now listed but not counted in either figure, because the chapters cover the same ground. That removes four objectives (c00-01 to c00-04) from the headline, which now covers 215 key objectives: 67 in effect (31 percent, previously 69 of 219, 32 percent). The significance-weighted share was recomputed for the 215 and is 30.5 percent (previously 30.9); the bootstrap range and rater agreement were not recomputed. No status, evidence or score on any record changed. Cross-references from 36 key objectives to related further recommendations were added.
title: Fuller enumeration made public; Foreword items no longer counted
